offers.name: Free AI Answer Report
offers.who: Any owner who wants to see what the engines currently answer about their site.
offers.deliverable: Eligibility checks on the next screen, then answer cards with the exact question, the quote, the engine, and the timestamp when the panel is running.
offers.refund: No payment and no email address. One live run per domain per day; a repeat visit returns the stored copy with its timestamp.

offers.name: AI Answer Audit
offers.who: An owner who already knows one answer is wrong and wants the census, the sources, and the files.
offers.deliverable: The report object in the section order of the published sample: the frozen buyer-question panel across named engines, a defect register in buyer words, the cross-surface consistency matrix, and the file set.
offers.refund: Cash refund on four printed classes, claimable within 14 days of delivery. The report stays delivered either way.
offers.exclusion: Diagnosis and files. We do not implement on this SKU. Implementation is the $2,400 sprint.

offers.name: Answer Correction Sprint
offers.who: One market and one product line, where the wrong fact lives on pages you can edit.
offers.deliverable: Canonical fact page live, structured data valid, crawlers unblocked, named first-party defects closed, third-party mismatches submitted, a day 10 measurement, and warranty rechecks at day 30 and day 90.
offers.refund: Acceptance is artifacts, not a model output. The day 30 rule and the classes it never fires for are printed in the terms.
offers.exclusion: Bounded implementation of a frozen list. This is not a retainer and not a citation guarantee.

offers.name: Correction Sprint Plus
offers.who: For 2 or more location entities, or 2 or more product lines that each need their own prompt panel. One market and one product line is the sprint above.
offers.deliverable: The same sprint work, run once per entity or product line, with a separate panel and a separate before and after table for each.
offers.refund: Same acceptance rule as the sprint, applied per entity or product line.
offers.exclusion: For 2 or more location entities, or 2 or more product lines that each need their own prompt panel. One market, one product is the $2,400 sprint.

A.name: Audit quality refund
A.summary: A cash refund, claimable in writing within 14 days of delivery. The report stays delivered.
classes: Files are missing or cannot be opened and parsed.
The report contains no defect a specialist would recognise as one.
The report missed a competitor you named that the engines recommend on the panel questions.
A fact you gave us in the intake is contradicted in the answers and is not logged in the register.
A.never: This refund never fires because an engine did not cite you or did not rank you.

B.name: Sprint credit
B.summary: The $490 applies in full to a sprint started within 30 days of audit delivery. After 30 days the credit expires and the files stay yours.

C.name: Sprint acceptance
C.summary: Acceptance is measured at day 30 on a de-personalized resample, three runs per question. It fires when the engine still quotes the old first-party string and cites a URL this sprint edited.
never: Entity collision with a similarly named business
Answers that come from training memory with no source cited
Franchise or directory name, address, and phone records the client does not own
Answers produced with search turned off
C.caps: The day 30 and day 90 warranty rechecks carry a 2 hour cap each. Work beyond the cap becomes an incident ticket.
